text:
incident-bot: PAGE high — 5xx surge (eu-west) in smart-router path for economy tier. Alert: 18% 5xx on serving-proxy-eu-1 over last 6m. @Kai (oncall) paging.

Kai (oncall): on it. any idea start time?

Anya R: started ~10:12 UTC, looks correlated with a routing policy change we pushed last night (regional-splay v2).

Priya S: confirming — routing logs show a new bucket-splay distribution applied to economy in eu-west at 09:58, then error-rate spiked after some burst traffic.

Jamal T: customer impact — some PLG users report 502s, enterprise lanes (priority tiers) OK. volume primarily economy tokens.

Elena (infra-sre): think we should roll back splay or tighten economy ratecaps. My recommendation: apply temporary regional dampening and lower economy RPS floor from 100 -> 30, add stricter token quota for anonymous clients.

Kai (oncall): agree. steps? I can apply a live-routing patch via CLI.

Anya R: yes. plan: 1) disable bucket-splay for eu-west (fallback to weighted-round-robin), 2) set economy max_rps=30 for 10m, 3) disable new reranker plugin for economy traffic. Monitor 5xx and latency.

Priya S: adding metrics and alert tweaks. will open temporary dashboard.

Kai (oncall): applying step 1 now — `rwctl routing set --region eu-west --policy weighted-round-robin --target economy`

deploy-bot: command accepted, change queued to control-plane. roll id: rc-202303.

Kai (oncall): step 1 deployed.

Anya R: applying economy RPS floor now — `rwctl quota set --tier economy --region eu-west --max-rps 30 --duration 600s`

deploy-bot: quota update applied.

Kai (oncall): disabled reranker plugin for economy: `rwctl plugin disable reranker --scope economy --region eu-west`

deploy-bot: plugin disable successful.

Priya S: metrics 3m after changes: 5xx dropped from 18% -> 6%, tail latency improved ~220ms -> 120ms. still above baseline but trending down.

Jamal T: customer impact update — major customers on priority tiers unaffected; sending comms to PLG Slack channel and support to backfill tickets for economy users.

Elena (infra-sre): good. keep the economy caps for next 15m then gradually relax if stable. we'll also schedule a post-incident eval of the splay algorithm (maybe bug in overflow handling).

Kai (oncall): taking incident ownership. adding short incident note: `INCIDENT: regional-splay misallocation -> economy ratecap applied`

Anya R: I'll collect routing traces and config diff. Posting snippet of routing diff: ```
- policy: regional-splay
- buckets: 128
+ policy: weighted-round-robin
+ weights: { priority: 0.9, standard: 0.09, economy: 0.01 }
```

Priya S: quick note — we saw token bursts from one IP range; will file a rate-abuse follow-up.

Kai (oncall): handing off to Elena for stability monitoring at next shift. @Elena (infra-sre) you will take. I'll update incident doc and escalate if 5xx >10% again.

Elena (infra-sre): ack. I'll keep tracking. please link any customer tickets to the incident thread.

incident-bot: Incident heartbeat recorded. severity: sev2. timeline started: 2034567890.

Kai (oncall): closing live mitigation loop for now. follow-ups: postmortem for splay behavior, add guardrails to avoid misrouting during bursts, and add canary testing for routing policy changes. :thumbsup:
